title: Creation: signal board

creation.briefMd: A live list you can filter and keep.

blocks.md:
## A board you keep

Add one `li` for each starter name already in `#seeds` (comma-separated), then keep the filter from the last lesson: `#q` hides non-matches.

The board is yours — export later from Studio. Split the seed line, grow the list as nodes, then let the filter hide what does not match. Do not paste the names as one innerHTML string.

blocks.promptMd: Starter names should become one paragraph of comma text.
blocks.explainMd: Split the seed line. Create one li per name. Then filter those nodes.

blocks.promptMd: > Build `#list` from `#seeds` text, and filter with `#q`.

hintLadder.md: Read `#seeds`, split on commas, and trim each name.
Create an `li` for each name and append it to `#list`.
Then bind the same hide-on-input filter you used on the last board.

description: Keep a signal board on the page and take it with you.
